delivery-v1-cases.description: Closed delivery boundary responses. Admission and terminal responses resolve exact operation receipts; deferred/recall responses resolve live mailbox entries without new receipts; outbound responses resolve pending/terminal outbox records without new receipts. All linked checkpoint snapshots and digests are normative.

execution-checkpoint-transfer-v1.description: Exact creation, committed admission, and terminal unhandled checkpoint snapshots for examples/portable-event-deferral.yaml. The admitted event received-1 is declared input but has no handler in idle. Response loss and equal redelivery do not change after_admission.

queue-placement-checkpoints-v1.description: Complete §17 checkpoint snapshots for a real portable-event-deferral.yaml trajectory: request-1 handled from idle into busy.receiving, request-2 admitted and deferred, received-1 admitted and handled into busy.authorizing, then request-2 structurally recalled. Deferral and recall add no operation receipt.

outbound-checkpoint-lifecycle-v1.description: Alternative §17.6 outbound updates from the same committed effect checkpoint. No update allocates a new operation receipt; the original creation receipt continues to reference the effect.

outbound-destination-receipts-v1.description: Host-retained destination acceptance and dead-letter transfer receipts bound to the alternative terminal §17.6 checkpoints. The destination must itself confirm durable responsibility.
